g.text: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr ◆ Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity ◆ US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO ◆ Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction ◆ SuperMe raises $20M for its network of AI expert profiles ◆ Agent identity startup Mintive lands Cowboy Ventures, Coatue, angels Jeff Dean, Andrej Karpathy ◆
